original_test_intent: Measure random read bandwidth and IOPS on the approved Windows storage target using CrystalDiskMark and compare the displayed result with the project specification.
original_method: A qualified operator records platform/device/tool identity, selects target and random-read-only item, verifies unrelated writes are disabled, runs once with approved size/count, saves full screenshot/export, records health/events and provides evidence for engineer verdict.
manual_activity: Qualified operator controls the Windows GUI, verifies target and random-read-only scope, runs the approved profile and captures evidence.
required_inputs: Approved Windows SUT and CrystalDiskMark version/checksum
Random-read profile, test size/count, cache/power policy and duration
Versioned read bandwidth/IOPS thresholds with units/tolerance
Health/thermal abort, evidence and cleanup policy
safety_requirements: Verify drive and random-read-only selection before Start
Disable unrelated default writes unless separately approved
Stop on wrong drive, unexpected write selection, device/thermal error or instability
No automatic retry or target alteration
agent_execution_scope: Review operator-supplied version, drive, profile, screenshot/export and health evidence
Compare recorded read metrics with supplied thresholds without claiming GUI control
Do not operate GUI, infer visual state, fabricate results or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Provide target, read-only profile and threshold
Ensure qualified operator captures complete GUI evidence

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects SSH execution, but does not ensure a random-read-only selection or complete drive/profile evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: MANUAL ONLY: operator selects the exact random-read-only CrystalDiskMark item on the approved drive and saves the unmodified table.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Random read, bandwidth/IOPS, Windows CrystalDiskMark and 20/30 planning fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed operator checklist binding drive serial, GUI build, random-read item, size/count and thresholds to screenshot/export evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit read-only scope, reproducibility, target identity and health checks.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Other GUI items or CLI tools cannot substitute without approved equivalence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Cache state, test size, queue/thread settings, filesystem and drive conditioning influence random-read values.

project_override_considerations: Project inputs select the exact random-read profile and thresholds; they must not be invented or replaced by the GUI default full suite.
expected_evidence: Operator/date plus Windows and CrystalDiskMark identities
Exact random-read-only profile, size/count and unmodified screenshot/export
Displayed read MB/s and IOPS mapped to thresholds

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, GUI procedure and spec comparison are aligned. Missing target/profile/threshold values are readiness inputs; the broad read/write wording is controlled by selecting the named random-read item.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A Windows operator can perform the read-only GUI case when inputs are supplied; remote-agent inability makes it MANUAL ONLY, not inherently blocked.

review_improvement: Prevents accidental default-suite writes and requires trustworthy target/profile/result evidence without claiming GUI automation.
independent_technical_reasoning: CrystalDiskMark's default suite can include writes even when the testcase asks only for random reads. The operator must visibly select the intended row and preserve profile/drive identity because queue/thread and test-size choices change both MB/s and IOPS. An SSH transcript cannot attest those GUI selections.
